//! Capture-only harness for tests/fixtures/mcp-structured-output/march-current-main.jsonl.
//! It is copied into an unmodified pre-#153 #152 source tree as tests/capture_march_current_main.rs,
//! beside a copy of march-current-main.cases.json named capture_cases.json, and run
//! there; the baseline's src/ is never edited. It drives March over real HTTP
//! (header omitted and explicit) and over the baseline's real binary bridge
//! (protocolVersion omitted and explicit), asserts the four transcripts are
//! byte-identical, and writes them with the requests to SWARMAIL_CAPTURE_DIR.
mod common;
use common::{http_send_text_with_headers, start};
use serde_json::{Value, json};
use std::process::Stdio;
use std::time::Duration;
use tokio::io::{AsyncBufReadExt, AsyncReadExt, AsyncWriteExt, BufReader};

const MARCH: &str = "2025-03-26";

fn historical() -> swarmail::model::Email {
    use swarmail::model::{Email, EmailAddress};
    Email {
        id: "historical".into(),
        inbox: "contract".into(),
        from: Some(EmailAddress {
            name: Some("Sender \"雪\"".into()),
            address: "from@x.io".into(),
        }),
        envelope_from: None,
        to: vec![EmailAddress {
            name: None,
            address: "to@x.io".into(),
        }],
        cc: vec![EmailAddress {
            name: Some("Cc".into()),
            address: "cc@x.io".into(),
        }],
        recipients: vec!["bcc@x.io".into()],
        subject: Some("quoted \"雪\" \\ subject".into()),
        received_at: "1969-12-31T23:59:59Z".into(),
        received_ms: -1000,
        size: 42,
        text: Some("line\n\t\u{0}\u{1b} 雪 \\".into()),
        html: Some("<b>untrusted</b>".into()),
        links: vec!["https://x.io/?q=雪".into()],
        codes: (0..65).map(|i| format!("{i:04}")).collect(),
        message_id: Some("message@x".into()),
        in_reply_to: Some("parent@x".into()),
        references: vec!["root@x".into()],
        raw: b"never exposed".to_vec(),
    }
}

fn minimal() -> swarmail::model::Email {
    let mut minimal = historical();
    minimal.id = "minimal".into();
    minimal.inbox = "other".into();
    minimal.envelope_from = Some(String::new());
    minimal.from = None;
    minimal.to.clear();
    minimal.cc.clear();
    minimal.recipients.clear();
    minimal.subject = None;
    minimal.text = None;
    minimal.html = None;
    minimal.links.clear();
    minimal.codes.clear();
    minimal.message_id = None;
    minimal.in_reply_to = None;
    minimal.references.clear();
    minimal
}

struct Binary {
    child: tokio::process::Child,
    input: tokio::process::ChildStdin,
    output: BufReader<tokio::process::ChildStdout>,
}
impl Binary {
    fn start(addr: std::net::SocketAddr) -> Self {
        let mut child = tokio::process::Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_swarmail"))
            .args(["mcp", "--url", &format!("http://{addr}")])
            .stdin(Stdio::piped())
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::piped())
            .kill_on_drop(true)
            .spawn()
            .unwrap();
        let input = child.stdin.take().unwrap();
        let output = BufReader::new(child.stdout.take().unwrap());
        Self { child, input, output }
    }
    async fn send(&mut self, request: &Value) {
        self.input.write_all(format!("{request}\n").as_bytes()).await.unwrap();
    }
    async fn line(&mut self) -> String {
        let mut line = String::new();
        let n = tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(30), self.output.read_line(&mut line))
            .await
            .unwrap()
            .unwrap();
        assert!(n > 0, "binary closed stdout");
        line.strip_suffix('\n').unwrap().to_owned()
    }
    async fn finish(mut self) {
        drop(self.input);
        let mut rest = String::new();
        self.output.read_to_string(&mut rest).await.unwrap();
        assert!(rest.is_empty(), "unexpected protocol lines: {rest}");
        assert!(self.child.wait().await.unwrap().success());
        let mut stderr = String::new();
        self.child.stderr.take().unwrap().read_to_string(&mut stderr).await.unwrap();
        assert!(stderr.is_empty(), "{stderr}");
    }
}

fn call(id: Value, name: &str, arguments: Value) -> Value {
    json!({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id": id, "method":"tools/call", "params":{"name":format!("swarmail_{name}"), "arguments":arguments}})
}

async fn transcript(version: Option<&str>, stdio: bool) -> (Vec<String>, Vec<String>) {
    let srv = start().await;
    let mut binary = None;
    if stdio {
        let mut b = Binary::start(srv.http_addr);
        let mut init = json!({"jsonrpc":"2.0", "id":"init", "method":"initialize", "params":{"protocolVersion":MARCH,"capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"revision-test","version":"1"}}});
        if version.is_none() {
            init["params"].as_object_mut().unwrap().remove("protocolVersion");
            b.send(&init).await;
            let reply: Value = serde_json::from_str(&b.line().await).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(reply["result"]["protocolVersion"], MARCH);
        } else {
            b.send(&init).await;
            let reply: Value = serde_json::from_str(&b.line().await).unwrap();
            assert_eq!(reply["result"]["protocolVersion"], MARCH);
            b.send(&json!({"method":"notifications/initialized"})).await;
            b.send(&json!({"id":"ready", "method":"ping"})).await;
            assert!(b.line().await.contains("\"ready\""));
        }
        binary = Some(b);
    }
    let mut requests = Vec::new();
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    let cases: Value = serde_json::from_str(include_str!("capture_cases.json")).unwrap();
    let mut seeded = Value::Null;
    let mut steps = vec![(json!({"id":1,"method":"tools/list"}), false, None)];
    for case in cases.as_array().unwrap() {
        steps.push((Value::Null, case["restore"] == true, Some(case.clone())));
    }
    for (mut request, restore, case) in steps {
        if restore {
            srv.store.insert(historical()).unwrap();
            srv.store.insert(minimal()).unwrap();
        }
        let name = case.as_ref().map(|c| c["tool"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned());
        if let Some(case) = &case {
            let mut arguments = case["arguments"].clone();
            if arguments["id"] == "$seed" {
                arguments["id"] = seeded.clone();
            }
            request = call(json!(2), name.as_deref().unwrap(), arguments);
        }
        let raw = if let Some(b) = binary.as_mut() {
            b.send(&request).await;
            b.line().await
        } else {
            let headers = version.map(|v| vec![("MCP-Protocol-Version", v)]).unwrap_or_default();
            let (status, raw) = http_send_text_with_headers(
                srv.http_addr, "POST", "/mcp", &headers, Some(&request.to_string()),
            )
            .await;
            assert_eq!(status, 200);
            raw
        };
        let normalized = if name.as_deref() == Some("seed_email") {
            let reply: Value = serde_json::from_str(&raw).unwrap();
            let payload: Value =
                serde_json::from_str(reply["result"]["content"][0]["text"].as_str().unwrap()).unwrap();
            seeded = payload["id"].clone();
            let id = seeded.as_str().unwrap();
            assert_eq!(raw.matches(id).count(), 1);
            raw.replace(id, "$SEED_ID")
        } else {
            if seeded.is_string() {
                assert!(!raw.contains(seeded.as_str().unwrap()));
            }
            raw
        };
        let logged = if seeded.is_string() {
            request.to_string().replace(seeded.as_str().unwrap(), "$SEED_ID")
        } else {
            request.to_string()
        };
        requests.push(logged);
        lines.push(normalized);
    }
    if let Some(b) = binary {
        b.finish().await;
    }
    srv.stop().await;
    (requests, lines)
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn capture() {
    let dir = std::path::PathBuf::from(std::env::var("SWARMAIL_CAPTURE_DIR").unwrap());
    let mut first: Option<(Vec<String>, Vec<String>)> = None;
    for (label, version, stdio) in [
        ("http-default", None, false),
        ("http-march", Some(MARCH), false),
        ("stdio-default", None, true),
        ("stdio-march", Some(MARCH), true),
    ] {
        let (requests, lines) = transcript(version, stdio).await;
        let body = lines.join("\n") + "\n";
        std::fs::write(dir.join(format!("{label}.jsonl")), &body).unwrap();
        std::fs::write(dir.join(format!("{label}.requests.jsonl")), requests.join("\n") + "\n").unwrap();
        if let Some((r, l)) = &first {
            assert_eq!(r, &requests, "{label} requests");
            assert_eq!(l, &lines, "{label} bytes");
        } else {
            first = Some((requests, lines));
        }
    }
}
